name: Natsu, Shin'ya, Coin Laundry
original_name: 夏、深夜、コインランドリー
source:
The protagonist (player), whose hobby is wandering around at night, is out on another lively night stroll.  
On the way, she spots someone she knows at the laundromat.  
No hesitation, go for it! 

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/7125]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
爱好在夜里四处闲逛的主角（玩家），今晚也一如既往地兴致勃勃出门夜游。
半路上，她在自助洗衣店里看见了一个熟人的身影。
别犹豫了，直接上吧！

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/7125]Novelgame[/url]]
